live_quirks: list_events returns `type` as a UUID-like string, not the documented "probability" -- identify the event by id/title, never by filtering type == 'probability'.

list_predictions / list_results grow monotonically and can exceed tool-result token limits late in the tournament -- prefer match-scoped checks during Depth Pass/submission, reserve the full pull for TRIAGE/SETTLE AUDIT (§4.4).
deadline_rule: hard lock = match opening_time (kickoff). Match-level closing_time observed live runs kickoff+2:30 (settlement window); API docs say market-level closing = match start. Earlier timestamp always governs.
